integrity: Analytic proof included; standard-library numerical diagnostics are supplementary, not infinite proofs. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Planar disks of positive radius only; convex nonnegative scalar ridge integrands, with radial-power corollary only for p>=1. No analogous claim for arbitrary convex bodies or all increasing radial weights. Historical priority against specialized circle mean/convex-order literature remains provisional.
title: Convex ridge weights restore inclusion monotonicity on nested circles
